status: Locally committed before Phase 17 outcome computation; not externally timestamped preregistration. Both corpora previously inspected; exploratory study.
question: Conditional on a fixed turn index, anchors, candidate windows and exact unique-word allocation, does prioritizing the frozen writer's anchor episode improve complete evidence-turn retrieval over count-matched random boundaries?
contribution: Controlled evaluation of a boundary-guided context allocation policy; not a new event-memory architecture or isolated effect of human semantic boundaries.
writer: Unchanged Phase 8 OnlineWriter; 64 minimum, 0.85 novelty, 160 maximum, previous 3 turns. Segments closed online, final history queried offline.
view: Original turn text, all released speakers; no role prefixes, labels, answers, timestamps, topic labels, summaries or memory flags in index, anchors or selection.
index: One common BM25 index of all nonempty turns per conversation/meeting. k1=1.2 b=0.75, lowercase Unicode regex words, unique query terms sorted for deterministic summation, chronological ties. Scores and ranking never depend on boundary condition.
anchors: Top 8 distinct nonempty turns (including zero-score ties if necessary), fixed across methods and budgets; each anchor is the lower middle word position of its turn. No use of question category or evidence.
cells: Within each anchor-containing session, sort anchor word positions and cut at integer midpoint+1 between successive anchors. Disjoint contiguous cells partition those sessions. Cells depend only on common anchors, not segmentation; other sessions cannot be entered.
allocation: Round-robin distribute B words across anchor cells in BM25 anchor order, skipping saturated cells, until exactly min(B,sum(cell capacities)) unique words allocated. Each cell receives one contiguous window of its assigned width. K, per-window widths, available source sessions and actual word cost identical across conditions.
candidate_windows: All integer start positions inside a cell whose fixed-width window contains its anchor word. Identical candidate pool in every condition. Windows may cut turns, never words; complete gold turn requires every word of that turn in the union of returned windows.
selection: Writer and random conditions maximize the window's word overlap with the segment containing its anchor; tie by absolute doubled-window-center distance to anchor, then earlier start. Centered baseline minimizes that distance, then earlier start. No-boundary ablation is mathematically identical to centered and must pass identity tests.
random_control: 20 seeds 0..19, exact-uniform valid whole-turn partitions with writer segment count separately in each session and max160 except a single overlong turn, existing Phase10 UniformCountSampler. Only turn lengths and writer count enter sampler. Retrospective diagnostic; segment lengths not individually matched. Output window lengths ARE exactly matched.
primary_endpoint: LoCoMo complete annotated nonempty evidence-turn coverage: per-conversation question mean, then unweighted mean of 7 conversations.
primary_contrast: writer minus arithmetic mean of 20 random conditions at 1024 words; seeds averaged within each question before conversation aggregation
hypothesis: Primary contrast >0. A useful benefit requires descriptive point effect >=0.02 and a 95% cluster-bootstrap interval above zero, plus no negative writer-minus-centered point effect. This is a prioritization threshold, not a confirmatory decision rule.
secondary: QMSum full-word coverage fraction of annotated nonempty relevant turns: query mean then equal meeting mean
any and all evidence turns, partial gold-word coverage, all gold sessions for LoCoMo
changed windows, selected windows, built boundary segments, candidate counts, exact unique words, distinct sessions
per-conversation and per-meeting differences, all random seed results
indexing, shared ranking and method selection wall time, process peak RSS
uncertainty: 2000 paired percentile bootstrap replicates seed17. LoCoMo resample 7 conversations equally. QMSum retain meeting-level estimand, resample 10 source families (AMI project prefix, ICSI Bed/Bmr/Bro series, committee covid/education), include all meetings within sampled family. Descriptive only; no independent-question p-values or seed-based significance.
eligibility: Frozen 599 LoCoMo questions unchanged; fail if a gold turn is missing or empty. QMSum all244 specific queries, inclusive spans; empty turns excluded from recall denominator with counts reported; fail if any query has no nonempty gold turn.
resource_plan: CPU standard-library core; no commercial API, model download or GPU. Target under30min and4GiB for this corpus; stop and diagnose if exceeded, never silently subsample.
integrity: frozen source hashes and recorded local protocol commit
disjoint windows, exact word count and equal selected-window/session counts
labels never passed into representation or selector APIs
limits: Boundary-guided allocation conditional on this policy and anchors; not a general causal effect of boundary quality
Candidate width, budgets and anchors fixed without tuning; other values not evaluated
Current writer is lexical novelty, not human semantic ground truth
QMSum labels are broad relevant spans, LoCoMo annotations may be incomplete
Matched built-boundary count does not match internal boundary spacing or event lengths
Session diversity is fixed by anchors and cannot improve through treatment
No answer generation, active/obsolete inference, human cognition or philosophical understanding measured
Both evaluation corpora reused, no independent confirmatory test
